definitions.gloss: fighting bravely; gallant fight; spirited struggle
definitions.explanation: Putting up a brave, determined fight despite difficult odds. Often used to praise athletes or competitors who showed great effort even if they did not win.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{敢闘|かんとう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The athletes fought bravely until the end.

examples.japanese: {敢闘賞|かんとうしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{力士|りきし}→力士：10115_rikishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦インタビュー→インタビュー：03833_intabyuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I interviewed the wrestler who received the Fighting Spirit Prize.

examples.japanese: ⟦{負|ま}け→負け：02569_make⟧はした⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧な{敢闘|かんとう}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧だった。
examples.english: They lost, but it was a magnificent display of fighting spirit.

notes:
Composed of {敢|かん} (daring, bold) and {闘|とう} (fight, struggle). Emphasizes courage and determination in the face of adversity, often used to praise effort regardless of outcome. Most commonly encountered in the compound {敢闘賞|かんとうしょう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {敢闘賞|かんとうしょう}: Fighting Spirit Prize (awarded in sumo, boxing, and other competitions)
- {敢闘|かんとう}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧: display of fighting spirit
- {敢闘|かんとう}⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧: fighting spirit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{奮闘|ふんとう}→奮闘：07901_funtou⟧: hard fight, strenuous effort — emphasizes exertion and struggle
- ⟦{健闘|けんとう}→健闘：15326_kentou⟧: good fight, creditable performance — emphasizes commendable effort; ⟦{健闘|けんとう}→健闘：15326_kentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧ is a common encouragement
- ⟦{善戦|ぜんせん}→善戦：07902_zensen⟧: good fight, putting up a strong showing — often used when losing narrowly
